title: Development and Validation of RP-HPLC Method for Buprenorphine and Naloxone Estimation
author: S. Bhavana
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare mobile phase
steps.instruction: Mix tri‑ethylamine buffer and methanol in a volume ratio of 32 : 68 (v/v) to obtain the mobile phase for the RP‑HPLC analysis.

steps.title: Configure HPLC system
steps.instruction: Install a Phenomenex Gemini C18 column (4.6 mm × 150 mm, 5.0 µm particle size), set the flow rate to 1.0 mL min⁻¹ and the detector wavelength to 248 nm.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
steps.instruction: Prepare Buprenorphine standard solutions covering 30–70 µg mL⁻¹ and Naloxone standard solutions covering 10–50 µg mL⁻¹ for linearity assessment.

steps.title: Inject samples and record retention times
steps.instruction: Inject each standard and sample; record the retention time of Buprenorphine (≈3.297 min) and Naloxone (≈5.405 min).

steps.title: Validate method per ICH
steps.instruction: Assess linearity (correlation coefficients 0.999 for both analytes), precision (%RSD < 2 % across all concentrations), accuracy (recoveries 100.1873 % for Buprenorphine and 100.748 % for Naloxone), assay (99.82 % of label claim), and determine LOD/LOQ (Buprenorphine LOD = 2.6 µg mL⁻¹, LOQ = 7.8 µg mL⁻¹; Naloxone LOD = 3.4 µg mL⁻¹, LOQ = 10.2 µg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Analyze commercial dosage form
steps.instruction: Apply the validated RP‑HPLC method to quantify Buprenorphine and Naloxone in the commercially available dosage form.
